title: Persist generation floor temp-file wedge on same-PID retry
description: P3, pre-existing mechanism newly reachable via the worker6-07cg conflict path (wave-2 review): rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs floor write (~:1678-1687) uses create_new temp file .floor.{pid}.{G+1}.tmp with best-effort cleanup (:1704-1706). If the floor write fails after the state blob succeeded and the temp file could not be removed, a same-PID retry at the same generation fails to create the temp again, wedging commits for the process lifetime. Self-heals on restart (blob G+1 >= floor G loads fine). Fix: on floor-write failure, unlink any same-generation temp file before raising, or retry with an exclusive-suffix counter; add an injected-failure test for double floor write.
